ingredients.text: 4 large bell peppers (any color or a combination of colors) - cored, seeded, tops reserved
ingredients.name: large bell peppers (any color or a combination of colors) - cored, seeded, tops reserved

ingredients.text: 4 ounces mild Italian sausage, finely chopped
ingredients.name: mild Italian sausage, finely chopped

ingredients.text: 1 cup fresh corn kernels or thawed frozen corn
ingredients.name: fresh corn kernels or thawed frozen corn

ingredients.text: 1 (5.6 ounce) package Knorr® Fiesta Sides™ - Spanish Rice
ingredients.name: (5.6 ounce) package Knorr® Fiesta Sides™ - Spanish Rice

ingredients.text: 1 cup shredded Mexican cheese blend or Monterey Jack cheese, divided
ingredients.name: shredded Mexican cheese blend or Monterey Jack cheese, divided

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees (190 degrees C). Spray an 8- or 9-inch square baking dish with cooking spray, and set aside. Finely chop pepper tops, and set aside.

Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high. Cook mild Italian sausage, corn, chopped sweet onion, and minced garlic until corn begins to turn golden and sausage begins to brown, about 5 minutes. Add ground beef and cook until browned, about 10 minutes.

Stir 2 cups water, Knorr® Fiesta Sides™ - Spanish Rice, and chopped pepper tops to the skillet. Cook according to package directions. Stir in 3/4 cup cheese and let stand 2 minutes. Stuff peppers equally with rice mixture and arrange in the prepared baking dish. Add 2 tablespoons water to the baking dish and cover tightly with foil.
Bake until peppers are tender, about 45 minutes. Remove and discard the foil. Sprinkle peppers evenly with remaining 1/4 cup cheese. Continue to bake until the cheese melts, about 2 minutes.

selected_review.text: Great recipe, only changes I made were that I used mild Italian sausage instead of chorizo because I could get any at the time. I also added half a chopped sweet onion and 2 cloves of fresh minced garlic, some sea salt and pepper. But great recipe and very flavour full and I will definitely be making this again!
